panels.title: Processing pipeline

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (SELECT greatest(count(*), 1) AS n FROM asset a WHERE a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a.visibility <> 'hidden'),
     hevc AS (SELECT greatest(count(DISTINCT "assetId"), 1) AS n FROM asset_video WHERE "codecName" = 'hevc')
SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM asset_job_status WHERE "metadataExtractedAt" IS NOT NULL) / t.n, 1) AS "Metadata",
       round(100.0 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT "assetId") FROM asset_file WHERE type = 'thumbnail') / t.n, 1) AS "Thumbnails",
       round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM asset_file WHERE type = 'encoded_video') / hevc.n, 1) AS "HEVC videos converted",
       round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM asset_job_status WHERE "facesRecognizedAt" IS NOT NULL) / t.n, 1) AS "Faces",
       round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM smart_search) / t.n, 1) AS "Smart search",
       round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM asset_job_status WHERE "duplicatesDetectedAt" IS NOT NULL) / t.n, 1) AS "Duplicate check"
FROM t, hevc

panels.description: Share of the library each Immich stage has finished. Machine learning (faces, smart search) waits until metadata, thumbnails and video conversion are done (apps/immich/ml-scheduler.yaml).

panels.title: Uploads (per 10 minutes)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(a."createdAt", '10m'),
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a."originalFileName" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}(_overlay)?\.(jpg|mp4|webp)$') AS "Snapchat import",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a."originalFileName" !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}(_overlay)?\.(jpg|mp4|webp)$') AS "Phone and other"
FROM asset a WHERE $__timeFilter(a."createdAt") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: New assets arriving: the Snapchat importer and the phone's backup.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(a."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.type = 'IMAGE') AS "Photos", count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.type = 'VIDEO') AS "Videos"
FROM asset a WHERE a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a.visibility <> 'hidden' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_char(a."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY') AS "Year",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.type = 'IMAGE') AS "Photos", count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.type = 'VIDEO') AS "Videos"
FROM asset a WHERE a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a.visibility <> 'hidden' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: When you take photos (hour of day)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lpad(extract(hour FROM a."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int::text, 2, '0') || 'h' AS "Hour", count(*) AS "Moments"
FROM asset a WHERE a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a.visibility <> 'hidden' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_char(a."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'ID Dy') AS "Day", count(*) AS "Moments"
FROM asset a WHERE a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a.visibility <> 'hidden' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: On this day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(year FROM a."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int::text AS "Year", count(*) AS "Moments"
FROM asset a WHERE a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a.visibility <> 'hidden' AND to_char(a."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'MM-DD') = to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon', 'MM-DD')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.description: Moments taken on today's date in earlier years.

panels.title: Where the moments are

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.latitude, e.longitude FROM asset a JOIN asset_exif e ON e."assetId" = a.id
WHERE e.latitude IS NOT NULL AND e.longitude IS NOT NULL AND a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a.visibility <> 'hidden'

panels.description: Every geotagged photo and video, as a heatmap.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.city AS "City", e.country AS "Country", count(*) AS "Moments",
       to_char(min(a."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM') AS "First", to_char(max(a."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Last"
FROM asset a JOIN asset_exif e ON e."assetId" = a.id WHERE e.city IS NOT NULL AND a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a.visibility <> 'hidden'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT e.country AS "Country", count(*) AS "Moments"
FROM asset a JOIN asset_exif e ON e."assetId" = a.id WHERE e.country IS NOT NULL AND a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a.visibility <> 'hidden'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: People

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(nullif(p.name, ''), '(not named yet)') AS "Person", count(DISTINCT f."assetId") AS "Photos",
       to_char(min(a."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM') AS "First seen", to_char(max(a."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Last seen"
FROM person p
JOIN asset_face f ON f."personGroupId" = p."personGroupId" AND f."deletedAt" IS NULL
JOIN asset a ON a.id = f."assetId" AND a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a.visibility <> 'hidden'
WHERE NOT p."isHidden" GROUP BY p."personGroupId", p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25
